```yaml
name: UI Core Components Tests
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-ui-core-components/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-ui-core-components/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency: 
  group: ui-core-components-tests-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ui-core-components-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.draft }}
    steps:
    - name: Free Disk Space (Ubuntu)
      uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
      with:
          tool-cache: false
          android: true
          dotnet: true
          haskell: true
          large-packages: false
          docker-images: false
          swap-storage: true

    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
        cache: 'yarn'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cd openmetadata-ui-core-components
        yarn install --frozen-lockfile

    - name: Install Playwright browsers
      run: |
        cd openmetadata-ui-core-components
        npx playwright install --with-deps

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cd openmetadata-ui-core-components
        yarn test

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: test-results
        path: |
          openmetadata-ui-core-components/test-results/
          openmetadata-ui-core-components/screenshots/
```
